description: The Mapa zelene of Bratislava-Staré Mesto is a public web map of the trees managed by the city's Old Town district, built on the GISPLAN platform. The map read on 2026-09-28 says it informs the public about woody plants in the district's care, based on a tree passport (inventory) prepared in 2022, and offers layers, search, a legend, notes, distance and area measurement and map export over a 2024 orthophoto. Coverage is the Old Town district of Bratislava. Access is free in the browser; no licence or data download is stated. Caveats: attributes per tree (species, size, condition) were not opened, and only district-managed trees are included. It supports urban heat and storm exposure studies, such as tree fall risk to streets and overhead lines, and green infrastructure planning in central Bratislava. Related record: data-montevideo-tree-census-2008 is a comparable city tree inventory.
